title: $G_2$-Manifolds from 4d $\mathcal{N}=1$ Quivers
summary: Inspired by quantum field-theoretic constructions of 4d $\mathcal{N}=1$ quiver gauge theories that flow to superconformal field theories (SCFTs), we construct 7d manifolds of $G_2$-holonomy, which geometrically engineer these quivers in M-theory. Field theoretically, the 4d quivers are obtained by flux torus compactifications of 6d $\mathcal{N}=(1,0)$ SCFTs. The 6d theory compactified on a circle gives rise to a 5d KK-theory, which has a geometric realization as M-theory on a non-compact elliptically fibered Calabi-Yau threefold.
